title: E-commerce for a Continence Care Brand
description: I led discovery, requirements definition, and information architecture for a direct-to-consumer shop selling certified medical devices for incontinence. The work ran from a two-day stakeholder workshop through to approved wireframes — defining how the platform could stay relevant, compliant, and commercially clear.
cardDescription: Discovery, requirements and information architecture for an online shop of certified medical devices for incontinence, from a two-day workshop to approved wireframes.
